blocks.html:
An ADU shall not be permitted in a basement or cellar of a building in the following locations, except as otherwise provided pursuant to the New York City Zoning Resolution:
   1.   Within the special flood hazard area in accordance with Appendix G.
   2.   Within the 10-year rainfall flood risk area.
   3.   Within the coastal flood risk area.
